sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended):

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Custom Product Builder for WooCommerce”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Go to any WooCommerce product and enable the product designer option

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin zip file from WordPress.org
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  6. Configure your first designable product

After Installation:

  1. Edit any WooCommerce product you want to make customizable
  2. Enable the “Custom Product Builder” option in the product settings
  3. Upload your product canvas image (base product photo)
  4. Add clipart images to your library for customers to use
  5. Save the product and test the designer on the frontend

For detailed setup instructions with screenshots, visit our documentation.
sections.faq:
What products can I customize with this plugin?

Custom Product Builder works with any WooCommerce product type. Popular use cases include t-shirts, hoodies, mugs, phone cases, jewelry, caps, tote bags, posters, and any print-on-demand merchandise. If you can upload a product image as a canvas, customers can design on it.

Is this plugin compatible with my WordPress theme?

Yes! Custom Product Builder for WooCommerce is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme. The product designer integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce’s standard product pages and checkout flow.

Do customers need design skills to use the product customizer?

Not at all. The drag and drop interface is intuitive enough for anyone to use. Customers simply select clipart, position elements, and see real-time previews of their design. No technical or design experience required.

Can customers upload their own images?

Image upload functionality is available in the Pro version. This allows customers to add their own photos, logos, and graphics to their product designs.

How is this different from Fancy Product Designer or Lumise?

Custom Product Builder offers a simpler, more affordable solution without sacrificing essential features. While competitors can be complex and expensive, our plugin provides an intuitive product designer at a fraction of the cost, with no external service dependencies.

Does this work with print-on-demand services like Printify?

Custom Product Builder is a self-hosted solution that gives you full control over the design process. You can use it alongside any fulfillment workflow, including print-on-demand services. The design files can be downloaded and sent to any printing service.

Can I charge extra for customization or premium clipart?

Yes! In the Pro version, you can set individual pricing for clipart and design elements, allowing you to monetize premium graphics and customization options.

Is the product designer mobile-friendly?

Absolutely. The drag and drop designer is fully responsive and works on smartphones, tablets, and desktop computers, ensuring customers can create designs on any device.

Do you offer support if I need help?

Free version users can access our documentation and community forums. Pro users receive priority support with faster response times from our dedicated team.

Is there a money-back guarantee?

Yes, we offer a 14-day money-back guarantee on all Pro purchases. Try it risk-free!
